correctness.rationale: The claim is a finite complete minimum problem. For each of the three source-classification generators, any competing nonerasing morphism with image length at most the claimed minimum has bounded positive image lengths r,s, hence belongs to an explicitly exhaustive finite set. The verifier enumerates all 276 such morphisms, excludes exactly mu^n and xi o mu^n, and tests factor membership using Proposition 2.1. It independently reconstructs Thue-Morse factors from parity-of-popcount bits and confirms the factor sets through length 13. Exactly two minimizers remain for each word, related by letter exchange.

value.rationale: The source's central finite theorem says every atypical Thue-Morse factor descends from exactly three generating words and proves atypicality by explicit local endomorphisms. Measuring the least possible local witness therefore gives a natural quantitative refinement of the complete exceptional set rather than an arbitrary slice. The result completely determines this invariant and all minimizers for all three generators; for aabab it also shortens the displayed source witness from 17 to 13.
